rationale: The agent appeared to identify the user and view their orders, but then initiated a return (return_delivered_order_items) targeting a different payment method than original, which conflicts with the stated system constraint (refunds only to original method or gift card). There is no evidence of explicit user confirmation before performing this order-changing write. Afterward, the agent escalated to a human, which is appropriate when the request cannot be fulfilled, but the prior attempted write without confirmation and to a disallowed payment method violates policy. Therefore, it does not meet the pass bar.
